# redirhub_domain (Resource)

A domain connected to the workspace. Its `dns_records` can feed your DNS provider's record resource, so the domain is connected in the same apply.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "redirhub_domain" "go" {
  host        = "go.example.com"
  short_links = true
}

# Point the domain to RedirHub in the same apply, here with Cloudflare.
resource "cloudflare_dns_record" "redirhub" {
  for_each = { for r in redirhub_domain.go.dns_records : "${r.type}-${r.name}" => r }

  zone_id = var.cloudflare_zone_id
  name    = each.value.name
  type    = each.value.type
  content = each.value.value
  ttl     = 300
  proxied = false
}

# Serve HTTPS from your own servers with Self-Hosted TLS: point the DNS at them, not at RedirHub.
resource "redirhub_domain" "shop" {
  host            = "shop.example.com"
  connection_mode = "self_hosted"
}

# Wait until your servers answer for it; its certificate follows.
resource "redirhub_domain_verification" "shop" {
  host = redirhub_domain.shop.host
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `host` (String) The hostname, e.g. `go.example.com`.

### Optional

- `connection_mode` (String) How the domain is served. `managed` (the default): its DNS points to RedirHub, which serves its redirects, links and HTTPS. `self_hosted`: your own servers run the RedirHub container and serve HTTPS for it with the certificates RedirHub issues and renews; point its DNS at your servers. Needs a workspace with Self-Hosted TLS. Changing it switches the domain in place.
- `force_https` (Boolean) Send HTTP visitors to HTTPS (Enterprise).
- `https` (Boolean) Issue and renew a certificate for the domain.
- `short_links` (Boolean) Allow short links and QR codes on the domain.

### Read-Only

- `dns_ok` (Boolean) Whether the domain was connected at the last check: its DNS points to RedirHub, or for `self_hosted` your servers answered for it.
- `dns_records` (List of Object) The records to create at your DNS provider. `managed`: the CNAME (or A record for an apex domain) and the TXT verification record. `self_hosted`: none for a hostname, whose DNS points at your servers; for a wildcard, the `_acme-challenge` CNAME that proves it. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dns_records))
- `id` (String) The hostname.

<a id="nestedatt--dns_records"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dns_records`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String)
- `type` (String)
- `value` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import redirhub_domain.go go.example.com
```
